shortBio.en: Queen drummer and high harmony voice; co-writer on several hits.
shortBio.zh: Queen 鼓手与高声部和声；多首热单共同作者。

body.en: Born 1949. Drummer from Queen’s formation; supplies falsetto/high harmonies in the studio stack. Remains active with Brian May on post-Mercury tours.
body.zh: 1949 年生。Queen 组建起的鼓手；在录音室叠轨中提供假声/高声部和声。后 Mercury 巡演中仍与 Brian May 合作。
